recipes.name: Roasted Garlic, Potato & Arugula Pizza
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C)*. Place the pizza crust on a baking tray and lightly coat with oil.
Place the roasted garlic onto the crust and mash it using the back of a fork, distributing it evenly over the crust.
To ensure the potatoes cook as quickly as the crust, slice them very thinly and evenly. Then layer them over the garlicky crust.
Sprinkle the thyme and salt over the pizza.
Bake on the centre rack of the oven for 13 to 15 minutes, or until the crust is golden and the potatoes are cooked through.
Meanwhile, combine the sauce ingredients in a small bowl.
Top the baked pizza with arugula, sun-dried tomatoes, olives, and pine nuts. Drizzle over the sauce, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection).
Storage Best enjoyed fresh out of the oven. Store leftovers in the fridge for up to 1 day.
